About Me

Building digital
experiences with
code & design.

My journey into technology began with a curiosity about how websites are built and how they appear on search engines. As I explored web development, I developed strong skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and later expanded into PHP and MySQL for backend development. Alongside development, I discovered my passion for SEO and graphic design, realizing that a successful website needs great design, strong performance, and good search visibility. Today, I combine these skills to create complete digital solutions — while continuously improving through practical projects, internships, and self-learning.

  • B.Voc IT Student — Sigma University
  • SEO Executive Intern
  • Web Developer
  • Graphic Designer

Career Goal — to become a Full Stack Web Developer, SEO Specialist, and Creative Graphic Designer who builds high-performance, SEO-friendly, and visually engaging websites, while contributing to meaningful products and continuously expanding my expertise in modern web technologies, digital marketing, and UI/UX design.
